subject: AVE, compRelSEM as well as reliability functions don't work

messages.author: df3c8b08ebbced1e
messages.subject: AVE, compRelSEM as well as reliability functions don't work
parts:
I run CFA model and try to establish validity and reliability.

Before these functions worked well, now they don't.

I reinstalled semTools as was recommended:
remotes::install_github("simsem/semTools/semTools")

Didn't fix the problem.

It gives the following mistake for AVE and compRelSEM:
object 'LAMBDA' is not found

And for reliability to get McDonald's Omega:
Object 'param' is not found Additionally: Warning: In reliability(fit_total_5) : The reliability() function was deprecated in 2022 and will cease to be included in future versions of semTools. See help('semTools-deprecated) for details. It is replaced by the compRelSEM() function, which can estimate alpha and model-based reliability in an even wider variety of models and data types, with greater control in specifying the desired type of reliability coefficient (i.e., more explicitly choosing assumptions). The average variance extracted should never have been included because it is not a reliability coefficient. It is now available from the AVE() function.
